static_traits.name: Chen Boran
static_traits.occupation: An entrepreneur launching a new juice bar
static_traits.social_status: Relationship with friends affected(avoiding beach Social gatherings); has friends to confide in, but they do not fully understand the Anxiety related to crowded environments
static_traits.medical_history: no significant physical illness; no past psychological problems or treatment experiences
static_traits.language_features: negative attitude; able to clearly describe Anxiety,Sense of frustration and specific situations

basic_info.main_problem: I feel overwhelmed by crowded beaches, unable to enjoy the beach, leading to frustration and Anxiety.
basic_info.core_demands: these anxieties affect my enjoyment of activities I love, such as surfing and reading at the beach.

core_beliefs: Only in a quiet, empty environment can I possibly relax and enjoy myself
crowds and noise completely ruin my experience, I cannot cope

special_situations.event: On summer weekends, beach crowds increase noticeably and noise rises
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if the environment is crowded and noisy, I cannot relax and enjoy; relaxing requires a completely quiet space
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids peak hours, tries deep breathing and mindfulness practice
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: the beach is always too crowded, I can never enjoy it again

special_situations.event: friends organizing Social gatherings at the beach (many people, crowded space)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if I show up in crowded occasions it will make me more anxious and spoil the fun, so avoidance is best
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: avoiding beach Social gatherings, reducing time in crowded occasions
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: even if I go I cannot enjoy it, it will only feel worse

special_situations.event: after Increased stress from starting a business, going to the beach for relaxation but seeing dense crowds
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if I lose my only tranquil haven, my stress cannot be relieved
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Obsessing over finding free time slots at the beach, concentrating relaxation needs on the beach option
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I already have no place left to decompress

special_situations.event: Observing the beach becoming more crowded for several consecutive weeks (especially weekends)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if it is crowded these weeks, it will stay crowded in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces the frequency of going to the beach, tries to avoid crowds but gradually gives up the beach
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: it will always be too crowded, impossible to enjoy again

core_conflict.wish: Longs to have a stable, quiet space to relax autonomously and restore oneself
core_conflict.fear: fear of being swallowed up by crowds and noise, unable to breathe, losing control and self
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of security and control by avoiding crowded places and seeking alternative locations

object_relations.self_representation: an overwhelmed seeker of peace needing tranquil shelter
object_relations.object_representation: intrusive crowds and environments that do not understand one's needs

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests exploring alternative relaxation places or reframing views of the beach
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: believing one has lost the only haven, alternatives not necessarily effective (staying skeptical of outside suggestions)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Interpreting the reasons for not going to the beach with objective reasons, emphasizing the beach is too popular with too many people, steady tone but firm in one's view, minimizing emotional expression.

manifestations: feeling personal space invaded, unable to relax and enjoy autonomously
the beach no longer a tranquil place for Freedom of choice
experiencing a sense of restriction of 'nowhere to go' and breathing difficulty
outcomes: Increased anxiety and sense of frustration
Avoiding beach socializing and peak hours
Daily relaxation disturbed, hard to recover body and mind

contact_model.definition: the individual restrains the urge to act toward other people or things, or gives up seeking others to do something for them, turning to do it to oneself instead -- i.e. Turning against the self the energy originally meant to be directed outward.
manifestations: Avoids peak hours, reduces time on crowded beaches
avoiding beach Social gatherings, turning dissatisfaction and tense energy into self-Repression and avoidant behaviors

positive_force: Actively tries coping (avoiding peak times, deep breathing, mindfulness practice)
Willing to explore alternative activities (hiking and quieter nature trails)
Has friends to confide in (though their understanding is limited)
Able to clearly be aware of and express his own feelings and needs
negative_force: Cognitive patterns such as catastrophizing, black-and-white, and overgeneralization
negative predictions about the future (believing the beach will stay crowded)
Dependence on the beach as the only haven and 'fear of missing out'
Rising stress from starting a business, leading to increased overall anxiety
breathing difficulty and intense discomfort in crowded occasions, prompting avoidance

target_behavior.behavior: significant anxiety and avoidant behaviors in crowded beach environments (including avoiding Social gatherings)
antecedent: The beach is crowded, especially on weekends
Increased noise; a feeling of personal space being invaded
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing cognition about crowds and noise and worry about losing the quiet haven (fear of missing out), and entrepreneurial pressure makes them more dependent on the beach as the main stress-relief channel
target_behavior.function: escaping unwelcome stimuli (crowds and noise), maintaining a sense of safety and control
target_behavior.consequence: unable to enjoy surfing and reading at the beach, social relationships affected, daily relaxation interrupted, business challenges worsened
